A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pharmacodynamic parameters of MMC are significantly different in bladder tumor fragments and established cell lines.
the pharmacodynamic parameters of MMC in cultured human bladder tumor fragments are markedly different from those of MMC in established bladder tumor cell lines.

the use of established tumor cell lines to predict MMC activity in bladder tumors may be misleading.
